title: Equip
description: The machine's record of how needs are met: references only, never secret values.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor validation. Ignored by the launcher.

equip.description: Equip file schema version. v1 is the only version this schema accepts.

secrets.description: Map of a need's secret name to a reference. env.NAME is the implemented form; keychain:NAME and file:<path>#key are reserved — accepted by this schema, not yet resolved by the launcher — and must round-trip here rather than be rejected as unknown.

providers.description: Map of "<need kind>.<class>" (e.g. gate.browser) to the chosen provider name.
